series.name: MDV outdoor 3-LED flash map (service guide)
series.notes: Midea MDV Service Guide outdoor 3-LED flash definitions (phase/pressure/current/sensors). Chiller/water tables quarantined.

codes.code: LED1 x1 blink; LED2 off; LED3 off
aliases: LED1 x1 blink; LED2 off; LED3 off

meaning.en: Power supply phase rotation does not match the outdoor board expectation.
meaning.ur: Power supply ki phase sequence board ki tawaqqo ke mutabiq nahi hai

causes.en: Outdoor PCB LED status combination reported by the MDV service guide.
causes.ur: MDV service guide mein bataya gaya outdoor PCB ki LED status combination

causes.en: Model-specific outdoor board diagnostic (36/48/60 kBtu class and similar).
causes.ur: Model ke mutabiq outdoor board ki diagnostic (36/48/60 kBtu class aur is tarah ki units).

solutions.en: Isolate power and verify LED1/LED2/LED3 pattern against this map.
solutions.ur: Power alag karein aur LED1/LED2/LED3 ka nishan is map se mila kar dekh lein.

solutions.en: Technician follows the service-guide flow for phasing, pressure or sensor repair.
solutions.ur: Technician service guide ke mutabiq phase, pressure ya sensor ki marammat ka tareeqa apnaye

source.title: Midea Service Guide — MDV central / digital scroll (via airconditioningmanuals.com)

notes.en: Scope: MDV commercial outdoor diagnostic LEDs (service guide section for universal outdoor boards).
